name: composio
description: Connect your agent to 1,000+ apps through Composio — managed auth, tool discovery on demand and sandboxed execution for Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Linear, HubSpot and more.

interface.shortDescription: 1,000+ apps for your agent with managed auth.
interface.longDescription: Let your agent work inside the apps you already use — send emails, post on Slack, open GitHub issues, update your CRM, read your calendar. Composio handles sign-in and permissions safely, finds the right action on demand and runs it for you. You approve anything that sends, posts or deletes.
defaultPrompt: Show me which apps I have connected through Composio.
Connect my Gmail so you can help with my inbox.
Find the right tool to create a task from this conversation.
